name: Blackrock Menace
summary: Redridge's Blackrock orcs press from the north and southeast, and Lakeshire is under siege. Marshal Marris asks you to thin their ranks and bring back their battleworn axes.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Lakeshire faces threats from several sides, but the Blackrock orcs are the gravest danger. They came south from the fiery Burning Steppes and now roam Redridge's craggy passes. After taking strongholds, they have penned townspeople inside Lakeshire. Trade, foraging, and travel along the northern roads have all been cut off.

sections.title: Striking the Vanguard
sections.body: Marshal Marris commands Lakeshire's beleaguered guard, but cannot spare soldiers to attack the orcs' positions. So he calls on you to strike their forward scouts and foot soldiers. Their crude, battleworn axes will prove they are dead. Marris hopes to thin the invaders near Stonewatch in the north and in the rugged pockets of southeastern Redridge.

faq.q: Where did these Blackrock orcs come from?
faq.answer: They marched south through jagged mountain passes from the Burning Steppes, where their ancestral stronghold lies around Blackrock Mountain.
Marshal Marris, Lakeshire's senior military officer, issues the order. He is responsible for defending the town and keeping order as it grows increasingly surrounded.

faq.q: Where can the Blackrock invaders be found?
faq.answer: The Blackrock invaders hold the northern highlands around Stonewatch Keep and footholds in the southeastern pocket of the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Marris ask for battleworn axes?
faq.answer: The battleworn axes give Marshal Marris physical proof that you fought and killed the Blackrock marauders threatening the valley.

faq.q: What happens after these scouts are defeated?
faq.answer: After the vanguard is thinned, Marshal Marris orders a strike against Tharil'zun, the local Blackrock leader entrenched in the mountains.

faq.q: Are the orcs affiliated with Thrall's Horde?
aliases: is blackrock clan part of thrall horde
faq.answer: No. The Blackrock clan here is made up of Old Horde remnants. They remain violently hostile to the Alliance and act independently of Thrall's new Horde in Kalimdor.

angles.text: For the Alliance, defending Lakeshire helps hold Stormwind's southern border against old-world adversaries.
As a human, facing the Blackrock clan in Redridge brings bitter grief. They destroyed the original Kingdom of Stormwind in the First War.
As a warrior, facing seasoned Blackrock marauders shield to shield tests your martial discipline and strength on the front line.
